arguments.code:
access_token = apis.spotify.login(username='ismill@gmail.com', password=[x['password'] for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords() if x['account_name']=='spotify'][0])['access_token']
# fetch all playlists (loop pages)
all_playlists=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    res=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token,page_index=page_index,page_limit=page_limit)
    if not isinstance(res,list) or len(res)==0:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(res)
    page_index+=1

playlist_summaries=[]
for p in all_playlists:
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=p['playlist_id'], access_token=access_token)
    songs=pl.get('songs',[])
    total_seconds=sum(s.get('duration',0) for s in songs)
    total_minutes=total_seconds/60
    playlist_summaries.append({
        'playlist_id': pl.get('playlist_id'),
        'title': pl.get('title'),
        'songs': len(songs),
        'minutes': total_minutes,
        'seconds': total_seconds
    })

max_pl=max(playlist_summaries, key=lambda d: d['minutes'])
rounded_minutes=int(round(max_pl['minutes']))
print('longest:', {k:max_pl[k] for k in ['playlist_id','title','minutes','seconds','songs']})
print('rounded_minutes:', rounded_minutes)
